scope: Resolve three further review findings in CSS comment parsing, cached CSSOM writes, and typed-event initialization. Custom-element lifecycle and previously documented DOM limitations remain excluded.

fixes.finding: Cached standard CSSOM writes bypass whitespace normalization
fixes.resolution: Trim standard-property values before retaining them as cached parsed state. Preserve existing custom-property write whitespace and existing important priority flags.
regressions: setProperty standard values match jsdom and reparsed attributes
Property assignments normalize whitespace without changing priority

fixes.finding: Quotes and delimiters inside CSS comments swallow following declarations
fixes.resolution: Skip comment contents during declaration tokenization, remove standard-property comments, and preserve comment tokens inside custom-property values. Quoted comment-looking strings remain literal. Inline CSSOM and computed-style declaration parsing share the scanner.
regressions: Quotes, brackets and semicolons in comments cannot change scanner state
Custom-property comment tokens and quoted text remain literal

fixes.finding: Typed event allowlist drops valid pointer orientation and input transfer fields
fixes.resolution: Retain altitudeAngle and azimuthAngle for pointer events and dataTransfer for input events, with defaults. Unknown-member filtering remains unchanged.
regressions: Paste/drop DataTransfer identity and text contents
Existing unknown getter fields remain unread

style_read_microbenchmark.statistic: Median milliseconds; lower is better. Fixed five-declaration element with repeated reads and no mutations.
style_read_microbenchmark.limits: Single invocation per condition, before heavy test jobs began. cssText was slower in this observation; no explanation or end-to-end suite performance claim is established by these measurements.

query_smoke.limits: Single run before native/integration jobs began. Query microbenchmark only; not an end-to-end suite speed claim.

wistia_integration: Root agent is running the unchanged 63-file compatibility selection; results will be appended after completion.
limits: This remains a partial DOM implementation and does not expand custom-element lifecycle support.
CSS comment handling fixes declaration tokenization; it is not a complete CSS grammar validator.
Existing custom-property whitespace behavior is preserved rather than broadened to full browser CSSOM conformance.
